desc: Run ingestion jobs (synthetic fixtures or the real Open-Meteo archive), import files, and inspect what landed.
createFirst: Create a farm and field first.
pickFieldHint: Pick a field above to ingest and inspect its observation history.
ingestDescSynthetic: Software fixtures for testing — always labelled SYNTHETIC downstream.
ingestDescOpenMeteo: Real historical reanalysis (gridded model estimates, never field sensors). Open-Meteo data is CC BY 4.0.
pickModelHint: Pick a consistent reanalysis product — never a silently changing best-match.
catalogError: Could not load the data catalog.
noCatalogVars: This provider publishes none of the catalog variables.
seedHint: Same seed + same inputs → identical series.
fixtureCoverage: Fixture coverage {start} → {end}; one job spans at most {years} years.
archiveCoverage: Archive coverage 1940 → present (a few days behind); one job spans at most 10 years per request.
pickVariable: Pick at least one variable to ingest.
noTempData: No temperature_mean data in this window.
provAllSynthetic: All plotted values are SYNTHETIC fixture data — demonstration only, never real measurements.
provMixed: Mixed provenance: {synthetic} of {total} plotted values are SYNTHETIC fixture rows (see the table for per-row labels).
ingestToSeeTemp: Ingest air_temperature_mean to see the line chart.
noPrecipData: No precipitation data in this window.
ingestToSeePrecip: Ingest or import precipitation to see the bar chart.
fileImportsDesc: Controlled import pipelines — files are validated row by row and never trusted blindly.
csvHelp: Upload rain-gauge / farm records as CSV (columns: date, variable_code, value, unit, notes). Rows land with the farmer_reported_record evidence class; blank values are stored as missing, never zero.
chirpsHelp: Upload a CHIRPS v3 GeoTIFF (EPSG:4326) — the service extracts the field-mean rainfall and records full raster provenance (product variant, nodata cells, sha256).
coverageDesc: What exists for {field}, per variable and per provider.
noObservationsYet: No observations stored for this field yet.
windowTruncated: · showing the first {shown} of {total} rows — narrow the window to see everything
emptyWindow: No observations in this window{scope, select, variable { for this variable} other {}} yet.
emptyWindowHint: Run an ingestion job or import a file above, or widen the loaded window.
